title: Console Tooling Standup - 2026-06-16
content:
Attendees: Aisha, Diego, Sofia, Markus, Priya (remote), Ben (briefly)

Agenda:
- Quick sync on UI work for rollout dashboards
- Analytics pipeline status and anomalies from last week
- Rollout automation: canary + rollback improvements
- Blockers and action items

Notes / Updates

Aisha - UI & Rollouts
- Finished first pass of the rollout detail page (shows per-model latency percentiles, error rate, and traffic split). Screenshots pushed to PR #287.
- UX feedback from PM received: add 'compare to baseline' toggle and make metric timeframe sticky. Added as follow-up task in ENG-4123.
- Working on linking the rollout actions to the audit logs; hit a caught-while-testing issue where the action button occasionally double-submits. Suspect debounce missing in frontend action handler.
- Next: patch debounce, add unit test, and coordinate with backend for idempotency header by EOD Wednesday.

Diego - Backend / Analytics
- Analytics pipeline caught an aggregation mismatch for model_id aliasing (some older records used legacy_model_id). Deployed a migration script to normalize values; ran on a small shard and results look good.
- Discovered a spike in 5xx for the rollout-metrics ingest endpoint on 2026-06-14 02:40 UTC. Root cause: a downstream dependency (metrics-forwarder) restarted and queue overflowed. Restarted forwarder and increased buffer limits; monitoring alert created (ALERT-ROLLUP-19).
- Plan to add backpressure handling and better retry semantics next sprint. Filed PR and linked in artifacts.

Sofia - Instrumentation & Dashboards
- Dashboard refresh: added percentile bands (p50/p90/p99) and a lightweight table for recent errors. Still tuning query cost - one of the queries is expensive for long time ranges.
- Working with infra to add materialized view for the error table to cut query time by 60%.
- Noted that log sampling for private deployments is causing missing samples for low-traffic models; opened RFC to standardize sampling config across environments.

Markus - Rollout Automation
- Canary automation now supports traffic ramp schedules and automated metrics checks (latency and error rate). Current check config uses static thresholds; need to hook into SLO service for dynamic thresholds.
- Ran a dry-run of a 10% -> 50% rollout using the new automation; rollback flow worked but the webhook notification lagged. Investigating whether webhook queuing or downstream processing is the delay.
- Action: add trace id to webhook payload to help debugging.

Priya - QA & E2E
- E2E tests flaked in the new canary rollback scenario (race between instance drain and cache warmup). Reproduced locally and added a small wait + health-check loop to test harness.
- Manual QA found an accessibility issue on the rollout modal (focus not trapped). Filed AX bug and prioritized for next sprint.

Blockers
- Frontend double-submit bug (Aisha) - blocking release of rollout detail page. Needs quick patch and backend idempotency header change.
- Expensive dashboard query (Sofia) - blocking wider rollout of long-range reports; depends on infra materialized view ETA Wed 06-17.
- Webhook lag in automation (Markus) - blocking full automation enablement for one customer; need trace ids in payload and investigation from infra team.

Decisions
- Ship rollout detail page behind feature flag once debounce patch and backend idempotency header are in place.
- For the short-term, use static thresholds for canary checks; integrate SLO-driven thresholds in next sprint (ENG-4208).
- Prioritize materialized view for errors table to reduce dashboard costs.

Action Items (owners)
- Aisha: implement debounce fix and open small backend PR for idempotency header (due 2026-06-17).
- Diego: finish backpressure changes for metrics-forwarder and add retries (due 2026-06-23).
- Sofia: follow up with infra on materialized view and update dashboard queries (due 2026-06-17).
- Markus: add trace id to webhook payload and run webhook latency test (due 2026-06-18).
- Priya: push AX bug fix and rerun E2E with new wait loop (due 2026-06-19).
- All: add relevant Jira links to the PRs and Slack thread for cross-team visibility.

Misc / Parking Lot
- Consider adding a lightweight synthetic load for the rollout webhook to surface latency regressions earlier.
- Need a small doc on rollout metrics semantics (what counts as an error, how to treat infra vs model errors) - assigned to Diego to draft.

Next meeting: 2026-06-23 10:00 AM PT (same Zoom, invite sent)

Quick notes: rough/working doc - will tidy up and link final PRs once patches merged.
